OVERVIEW & PHILOSOPHY

WHAT IS STEAM WASH?

DEEP CLEAN. PRECISE CARE. 100% CHEMICAL-CONSCIOUS SANITIZATION.

Our commercial-grade vapor steam generators deliver 160°C dry steam that instantly breaks down grease, spilled liquids, smoke residues, and allergens without soaking your interior upholstery. It reaches deep into air conditioning ducts and seat stitching for complete sterilization.

ESTIMATED DURATION: 1 - 2 Hours
ADVANTAGES & BENEFITS

KEY ADVANTAGES OF STEAM WASH.

01 / BENEFIT

99.9% Pathogen Elimination

Steam heat kills bacteria, mold spores, viruses, and allergen build-up.

02 / BENEFIT

Odor Source Neutralization

Destroys odor-causing bacteria rather than masking with perfumed sprays.

03 / BENEFIT

Zero Harsh Residue

Chemical-free cleaning safe for children, pets, and allergy sufferers.

04 / BENEFIT

Rapid Cabin Dry Time

Low moisture steam ensures seats are dry and ready for use in under 30 minutes.

Every step executed with certified detailing procedures, filtered spot-free water, and lint-free equipment.

PRECISION PROCEDURE

OUR APPLICATION PROCESS.

01

Dry Vacuum

Deep suction removal of loose debris from carpet and seats.

02

AC Vent Purge

Injecting high-temperature dry steam through ventilation lines.

03

Upholstery Steam Clean

Steam agitation across seat fabrics, seams, and headrests.

04

Trim & Crevice Purge

Steam wand lifting grime from cup holders and switches.

05

Extraction Wipedown

Microfiber capture of lifted oils and moisture.

06

Cabin Air Sanitization

Final air circulation cycle ensuring fresh cabin atmosphere.
